title: Zara 'BENITO ANTONIO' Collection Pre-Announcement Coverage Wave Hits Major Outlets — Bad Bunny Prepares to Depart for Europe
detail: On May 19, 2026, the first wave of official announcement coverage for the Zara x Bad Bunny 'BENITO ANTONIO' collection landed across major entertainment outlets — two days ahead of the global midnight ET launch on May 21. Multiple music radio platforms published the announcement simultaneously, framing the collection in the context of the Puerto Rico pop-up launch that had just generated viral coverage at Plaza Las Américas. The 150-piece collection, named after Bad Bunny's real name (Benito Antonio Martínez Ocasio) and designed with longtime creative director Janthony Oliveras, was described as the largest fashion collaboration of his career. The announcement wave coincided with final preparations for Bad Bunny's departure to Europe for the Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour's European stadium leg, with the Barcelona opening night at Estadi Olímpic Lluís Companys confirmed for May 22 — both nights sold out at 54,000 capacity. The convergence of a major fashion launch and the imminent European tour opening marked one of the most concentrated weeks of Bad Bunny cultural activity in 2026.
